value.title: statusline-generation-badge
value.summary: Claude and omp status bars prefer the rs seat id when a pane is present in both stores, and show a small yellow `rs` (or a dim `legacy`) tag naming which daemon the id came from.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Jordan 2026-09-02: 'in the Claude status bar, if we have old and new id, it is showing the old id — show the new id as preference and a little rs in front in yellow to indicate which one it is coming from. Same for omp.' Today: ~/.claude/statusline-context.sh:37-51 shells `pij whoami` (the legacy tsx CLI: slow, and it resolves LEGACY first for dual-present seats) and renders ⛓ <id>. omp renders the id via pi.setSessionName (plan 125, .pi/extensions/pij/index.ts + core/session-name.ts). Dual presence is now common (helper migration 2026-09-02: 20 seats + 4 primes have both ids; map in governance briefs/seat-id-map-2026-09-02.md). Plan 128 (in flight) adds `generation` to sessions rows; do not depend on it — resolve by pane against rs first.

sections.name: goals
value: G1 Claude statusline: resolve the pane against rs FIRST using the Rust binary (`pij-rs whoami`/state by $TMUX_PANE, or POST /v1/whoami with the pane; milliseconds), fall back to legacy `pij whoami` only when rs has no row. Render `<yellow>rs</yellow> ⛓ <id>` for rs, `<dim>legacy</dim> ⛓ <id>` for legacy-only. Never spawn the tsx CLI when rs answered.

G2 omp: session name becomes `rs·<id>` (or the closest the native segment allows); if the segment cannot colour, ALSO set the pij status row with a yellow `rs` via ctx.ui.setStatus so the generation is visible. Legacy-registered omp shows `legacy·<id>`.

G3 Ship the canonical Claude statusline script in the repo (harness/scripts/claude-statusline-pij.sh) and have the plan-126/127 installer ensure it is what settings.json statusLine.command points at (backup the operator's current script first; preserve every non-pij segment of the existing script byte-for-byte by extracting the pij block into a sourced snippet rather than rewriting the whole file, if that is cleaner — PM decides, records).
G4 Cost: statusline render path must not exceed ~50ms when rs answers; measure and paste.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No change to which id a seat IS (that is plan 129).
No adopt/registration from the statusline (ruled, plan 127).

value.text: LIVE: a hand-started Claude in tmux on a pane present in BOTH stores (e.g. a helper-migrated seat, or adopt a fresh one then confirm it has a legacy row) shows `rs` in yellow followed by the rs id; capture pasted.
value.claim: dual-present panes show the rs id with a yellow rs tag

value.text: LIVE: a legacy-only Claude pane shows `legacy` (dim) and its legacy id; a pane in neither store shows nothing; captures pasted.
value.claim: legacy-only and unregistered panes render honestly

value.text: LIVE: a hand-started omp shows `rs·<id>` in its footer (and the yellow status row if the segment cannot colour); capture pasted.
Measured: statusline script wall time with rs answering ≤ 50ms over 10 runs (hyperfine or time loop), pasted; legacy fallback path measured too.

Installer unit tests (RED-first): points statusLine.command at the shipped script, backs up the previous, no-op on rerun, malformed settings refused; existing hooks untouched. typecheck/cargo/harness checks green.
value.claim: installer is additive, idempotent, and refuses malformed input
